dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell us about your relationship to this castle...

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: You've guessed it already, I reckon. In the past, when I could still change my form freely, he... and I, and many of our companions dwelled here.

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: In those days, a new nation had just been born, and as far as we were concerned, the possibilities were yet endless.

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: Here, we organized the classics, researching music theory and magic, in the hopes that we might tame this perilous power and use it to open up a brighter age.

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: But... These possibilities would quickly become lost to us, and I alone remained...

dialogues.speaker: Monsieur Os
dialogues.text: It's fine. These things happened a long time ago.
